physics: Soft exits should only be ignored when the held side is either high-confidence or still clears the executable exit bid; this keeps winner-recovery upside while shrinking suppressed full-loss risk.
rule: Suppress value-over-hold soft exits when p_hold >= 0.85 or p_hold - exit_bid >= 0.00. Suppress probability_reduce exits only when p_hold >= 0.79 and p_hold - exit_bid >= 0.00. Keep collapse exits unchanged.
